acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for framing your remodel in Daly City, look for an experienced general contractor who has a strong portfolio of similar structural remodel projects. Verify their licensing with the California Contractors State License Board and ensure they carry adequate insurance. Request references and review past client testimonials. Discuss their process for handling permits and inspections specific to Daly City. A reputable contractor, like City Dweller, LLC, will provide a detailed proposal, clear communication, and demonstrate a thorough understanding of local building codes and quality construction practices.
